_note: Daytime backfill (gacrawl/backfill.py): back-to-back runs from the morning until candidate profiles stop filling. Set enabled to false to stop it; delete state/backfill.json's done flag (or the file) to start over. month_minutes_cap counts every Crawl run's Actions minutes this month (month_minutes_before adds runs from before counting began). Sized for GitHub Free (about 2,000 included minutes) plus the $30 Actions budget (about 5,000 more): 4,500 leaves about 2,500 for the rest of the month's nightly runs so the budget's hard stop never cuts them off. Catch-up through Sunday night (until), around the clock; from free_after every run is sized to stay inside GitHub's free 2,000 minutes a month (free): 2 crawl jobs x 14 minutes nightly, short research, one 15-minute police run a night, four nights a week (Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun; every step's time cap quartered). About 1,800-2,000 minutes a month. On the public runner (minutes free) runner overrides these: 8 x 45-minute crawl jobs at night, 6 for a run started by hand, 3 parallel feed/API jobs per daytime backfill run, 200 minutes of candidate research and 40 of finance per run, 60-minute police runs, 40 minutes of police news. Still polite: every site keeps its own delay and the off-peak window for pages.
